assumptions.assumption: The per-account average balance is taken over all of the account's transactions with amount > 2400, including those of type VYBER or with a missing type. Only the signed-amount figure leaves those rows out. As a result, an account whose only large transactions are of other types is still counted in the balance average, but skipped in the signed-amount average.

assumptions.assumption: The average balance is computed over all transactions with amount > 2400 for each account, including those of type VYBER or with missing type, which are excluded only from the signed-amount figure.
The final average of the balance figure covers every account with at least one qualifying transaction. The signed-amount average skips accounts with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ rows, because AVG ignores NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: The per-account average balance uses only the transactions that count toward the signed amount (type PRIJEM or VYDAJ), so both figures cover the same set of rows and accounts.

assumptions.assumption: Each account's average balance is taken over all of its transactions with amount > 2400, including those whose type is neither PRIJEM nor VYDAJ (e.g. VYBER). Only the signed-amount figure excludes those types.
Accounts that have no PRIJEM/VYDAJ transaction above 2400 still count in the cross-account average of balance, since the request says they are skipped only for the first figure.

alternatives.interpretation: Both figures are computed only from PRIJEM/VYDAJ transactions with amount > 2400, so the balance average also leaves out other or missing types and accounts without signed transactions.
